title: Scale Carbon Projects with Reliable MRV
headline: Scale Carbon Projects with Reliable MRV
question: How might we improve measurement, reporting and verification (MRV) and expand small carbon projects through suitable partnerships to build a scalable portfolio of credible emissions reductions and removals?
background: A shipping and logistics group wants to develop carbon projects beyond its existing small initiatives. Its projects are individually too small to scale efficiently, and limited access to underlying land creates additional investment and development challenges.

The objective is to establish reliable project-level MRV, identify suitable projects and partners, and expand through joint operations, joint ventures or dedicated project companies. Relevant startups bring capabilities in carbon project development, environmental monitoring, geospatial analysis and project documentation.
Nature-based innovation is the main focus. Other non-blue-carbon project types are also welcome; blue carbon is excluded.

significance.body: Small initiatives face barriers to becoming a larger, viable portfolio.

significance.label: Higher development costs
significance.body: Separate monitoring and documentation processes increase the work required for individual projects.

significance.label: Verification delays
significance.body: Incomplete baseline data, monitoring records and supporting evidence slow assessment and verification.

significance.label: Project-development barriers
significance.body: Land access, project rights and partner expertise are central to feasible investment and expansion.

efforts.label: Current company approach
efforts.body: The group has developed an internal carbon calculator and is seeking additional project-development and MRV capabilities to support expansion.

efforts.label: Available partner capabilities
efforts.body: A nature-based project provider offers individual-tree tracking and a partnership supporting project development and verification documentation. A geospatial assessment provider offers land-boundary validation, supplier-evidence collection and forest-risk analysis. A secure document platform provides controlled access to project records and supporting evidence.

efforts.label: Collaboration focus
efforts.body: Connect project screening, monitoring and evidence preparation through a carbon-specific MRV process. Build a practical model for expanding or combining suitable projects, with independent validation and verification integrated into the project-development workflow.
